question: Which AI lab will have the top-scoring model on the Arena "Creative Writing" leaderboard on December 1, 2026?

calls.reasoning: As of Oct 28/Nov 4 2026 the Arena creative-writing board is led by Claude Opus 5.5 (1520) over Gemini 4 Argon (1517) and Gemini 4 Carbon (1515), all within CI. Status quo favors Anthropic, but Google has two models within 5 points, Gemini 4 Carbon tops the overall text arena (1528) and markets heavily favor Google for overall text at end of November (Polymarket ~72% Google, Kalshi Carbon ~77%; that is a different contract, overall rather than creative, so it is evidence, not an anchor). Opus 5.5 is new with few votes, so its score is volatile. Rumored November releases (GPT-6.2, Grok 4.8, Claude Fable 5.5 ~Nov 30) add tail risk; OpenAI/xAI have historically trailed on creative writing. No market on the creative-writing category was found.
calls.dossier:
- Arena creative-writing (benchleader mirror, data dated 2026-10-28): 1 Claude Opus 5.5 (high) Anthropic 1520; 2 Gemini 4 Argon (high) Google 1517; 3 Gemini 4 Carbon (high) Google 1515; 4 Claude Fable 5 1501; 5 Claude Opus 4.6 1499; Meta Muse Wonder ~1487; best OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol ~1469 (modelmenu mirror). No xAI model appeared in the top 15.
- Search snippet (af.net/officechai, 'as of 4 Nov 2026'): same ordering, Opus 5.5 1520 > Argon 1517 > Carbon 1515.
- modelmenu mirror shows Opus 5.5 with only 194 votes, so a new model with a wide CI.
- Sophon mirror (different scale) also shows Opus 5.5 narrowly ahead of Gemini 4 Argon (1227 vs 1222); Arena updates roughly weekly.
- Gemini 4 Argon GA 2026-10-13; Gemini 4 Carbon announced 2026-10-28 with restricted access, wider rollout rumored for November. Carbon is #1 on the OVERALL text arena (1528).
- Prediction markets for the OVERALL text arena at end of November (not creative writing) strongly favor Google; Kalshi favors Gemini 4 Carbon. No market found for the creative-writing category.
- Rumored (unconfirmed) November releases: GPT-6.2 Astra/Sol (Nov 2-15), Grok 4.8 (Nov 19-30), Claude Fable 5.5 (~Nov 30), Gemini 4 Flash (~Nov 25), Qwen 4 Max (~Nov 16).
- Resolves off the arena.ai creative-writing leaderboard ranked by labs (highest Model Score), checked on or after 2026-12-01; tie goes to higher model rank. Fallbacks: Wayback snapshot, then the HF lmarena-ai leaderboard-dataset.
- Event window: point-in-time check on 2026-12-01; as of 2026-11-06 about 25 days remain.
- Status quo: Anthropic #1 by 3 points over Google.
- Could not access arena.ai directly (403); could not find CI values for the top 3.
calls.reference_class: Arena creative-writing #1 lab over 2024-2026 monthly snapshots (Google and Anthropic alternating at the top, OpenAI occasionally), conditioned on a 3-5 point lead ~25 days out

calls.reasoning: Status quo (Oct 28-Nov 6 snapshots): Claude Opus 5.5 1520 leads Arena creative writing over Gemini 4 Argon 1517 and Gemini 4 Carbon 1515, within CI. A leader usually holds over a 25-day window, but Google has two models within 5 points, so it only needs one to pass Opus. Carbon is fresh and only partly released, and Opus 5.5 may have few votes, so the top is volatile. Overall-text markets favour Google (~72-77%), but that is a different category where Anthropic is relatively strong. Rumoured Anthropic releases (Fable 5.5 / Opus 5.6) are a modest upside. OpenAI, xAI and Meta trail by 30-50+ points; rumoured GPT-6.2 or Grok 4.8 launches are tail risks. No market covers the creative-writing category.
calls.reconciliation: All three dossiers agree on the facts: the same top-3 scores (1520/1517/1515), Carbon's Oct 28 restricted release, no OpenAI/xAI model in the top 15, Meta best ~1487, and no market for this category. The run spread (Anthropic 0.44-0.52) is pure judgment over three things: how much the 3-pt status-quo lead counts against Google's two shots within CI plus Carbon's possible upward drift and broader rollout; how much to weight overall-text markets (different contract, so evidence not anchor); and the rumoured Anthropic release. Unsettled factual point: Opus 5.5 vote count/CI (one run cites 194 votes) cannot be verified without web access; I treat it as added volatility, which trims Anthropic's status-quo premium. Net: Anthropic slight favourite, Google close behind.
